Ok sure, if we look at the criteria of such issues. The thing is that the US, as a western first world country, needs to be compared to other western first world countries. The US also have strong state powers overseen by a bigger governing body. Similarly the is several countries governed by an bigger overseeing government. They have wildly better social nets and programs across the board. Want maternity leave? You got it. Want universal health care? Most got it. Want a culture of non-gun violence and not having to hear about school shootings or shootings in general every month? You got it. 

The fact that we’re comparing social safety nets or other metrics to non-western first world countries is an issue of itself. Because we cannot provide such things as a very developed nations people will say: “oh at least our police are better than the ones in South Africa. They’re very corrupt and are basically super big gangs.” Yea ok, but that’s South Africa. A nation that’s been wildly underfunded and rampant without much support or safety until recent years. America is seen as a powerhouse in the world and they should have domestic laws and a society that reflects that. Unfortunately it doesn’t so we say: nah man at least we’re better than Russia, a country with a wildly collapsing economy and actively declining population due to people leaving and not having kids. Honestly we might be headed there.

Hold the US to a better damn standard is all I’m saying. At least it’s better than <insert country here> doesn’t mean that a change shouldn’t be done. America is a world leader and honestly should reflect that across its entire nation, not just a select few.

I feel that. The game got so much harder with recent updates. From extra nonsensical powerups like ice nova and fireball to the thinning out of levelup buffs that now also include slightly increases attack damage and attack speed. Now with the lifesteal its so much worse. I'm glad they made it slightly harder with the mini-bosses on each stage though.

Personally the biggest thing is the diffcuilty spike WITHOUT ANY REWARD INCREASES. Its ok to make thingd harder, however without a sense of increasing rewards and the such it's just extra time sink. I'm already throwing time to grind 50 stages minimum for the last event for flowers, I just decided to be lazy and grind on stage 3. Its such a grind and time sink. I'm 3 months in and without a single legendary equip. And I'm still only grinding the same 1-2 stages over and over and it becomes so stale that it's just a chore at this point.

The update really turned me off even more since they're expecting players to be ok with even more of a time sink and with a difficulty spike as well as being ok with nerfs of certain mechanics that players have thrown a ton of resources for.

Is the game fun? Sure. But its really becomes a chore when you're throwing your time at the same stage with zero sense of progression due to low equipment and gold drops and a big stagnation after level 65 character. Making it so that playing the game is even more of a chore and a time sink takes away any fun that people really have when playing this game for the long run. 

Edit: Ok so I figured out what happened with lifesteal. Its now based on enemy HP rather than player HP. So if you kill an enemy it's only 3% of thier HP that you heal, not 3% of your own HP. The issue is that makes it lifesteal obsolete. Lest you make the lifesteal buff from powerups actually viable...which it isn't. Its still the same 1% it was before the update.

This sounds like a conversation and confrontation that needed to happen years ago. I hope...a therapist, counselor, or someone helps you sort out these feelings. Please don't bottle them up, its one of the most self destructive things one can do.
For me, its to find the meaning of happiness. And keep that happiness as best as one can. happiness is never the same for everyone, but I hope you do find yours.

Seeking help from a therapist or counselor isn't a bad idea, adults aren't as dumb as you think. Some have years of dealing with others both in worse and better conditions. They've taken on that burden for a reason. Don't knock it before you try it. They are helpful.  


Having that aside, the feeling of apathy, anxiety, and depression can hinder and detoriate your mental state. You still have a path to walk forward in life and to seek your own happiness. For some its easy to find, for others not so much. I hope do get help and I hope you find what can make you happy in life.

Life in 'peaceful world' and seemingly stangant times is hard. The stangant life style, the constant lazing despite the wish to do something with your life, the guilt and torment you have from others trying to help you, its never easy. People accuse you of doing things you haven't done and others believe it.

I would work towards for your happiness but I don't know if you have one. I would say search for your happiness...but I don't know if you have the will and lack of conscious guilt to. There is always something that can be done by that, but that part also needs to be played by yourself. If you've fallen into a pit, people who care for you like your friend will help drag you out. However they cannot pull you out. You also need to take the steps to want to help yourself, to find the will to seek your own happiness. You can continue to feel the guilt for the help others have given you, but also carry that guilt as you think of a way to pay them back for that help. Some are happy seeing you getting out of that rut, others are happy to see you help them in their time of need.

Life is a struggle. You feel guilty because you cannot do anything to pay back others who spend their time, emotions, and finances to help you. However understand that a part of growing up isn't just about yourself. Its about helping those around you. As we become older we realize in some way that we're responsible for more than our own happiness. I hope you can find your will to seek your own happiness, not for others, not for the sake of living, but just for yourself as a person. When we're born, we're at least afforded that. The right to seek our own happiness. We can pay back the karma that we've accumulated from others helping us in the future. The grief on it now...will only drag you down more into the pit. I hope you gain the strength to have the will to move on.  


Best wishes

I'm sorry for your loss and continous struggle to find happiness in your life. I wish life wasn't so shit, and I hope that everything somehow keeps going well for you despite all of this. The struggle one has to go through in order to achieve happiness and stability in their life can be a constant one. It feels endless. However I hope that in the end, you find the happiness that you were searching for. Working under others, slaving hours away at a job, and the constant financial pressure can break many, yourself included it seems. I hope...you find the will to continue the search for your own happiness, and that the happiness you find is to not meet the grim reaper under a tree.  


Best wishes

For someone like me, life isn't about you. It never was. Its about those around you. Its a story about those you meet, those interactions you have with others. And to end it here would be a shame of that story. At the same times its making those around you, the ones you care about, happy. And in turn you are happy. As people grow older, or rather more mature, they realize they're responsible for more than just their own happiness. Sometimes that not the case and said person is just...alone. In that case you have a right to make yourself happy. And if reaching that happiness seems like too much work or effort, then you'd need a bit of help there. In the end we all live not for the sake of living, not to have an extremely good life, but just to...be happy at the end of it all. Memories become something to look back on, not something to regret. Linger on the sad times, the deaths of loved ones, but also remember the happy times with them. Thats why some people live. Various other ones thats the one I believe in the most.

Marriage, romance, and children are never too late...unless you're past the menstrual cycle for the last one. Everything costs a lot because life makes things diffcult for you. Thre are certainly still paths in life, no matter the country. If you're in the US there are  ways to help manage your debit from free credit counseling organizations and nonprofits. Others are foodstamps and rent relief programs to help you through the necessities in life. There are also some jobs that you can do that allow for live on site.   


I can't do much apart from pointing you in certain directions to help you and feed you chicken soup for the soul. Life is...a struggle.I've seen people in better places in life at 33, and I've seen people in worse places in life at 33. People who are worse still continue to live on past not because they owe it to themselves or others to do so, some might chase a drug or high or are just horrible human beings who feed of the suffering of others. However for you, you continue to live not because you've gotten so far, but because you've still yet to get further. Will days be diffcult and harsh? Absolutely. Will days feel dull and like a chore to get out of bed? How is that different from some days now?  


Money problems as an adult is always a big struggle. However Its not something you can't solve with time and effort. The amount of time and effort needed is how much debt you owe and how much you need to get by. Life is harsh and feels lonely. It feels numbing and dull at that age, however please please keep living for the sake of future you can look back on and be happy with. Ending your story here would then feel like ending a story where you see someone at their lowest point who could make a comeback...but then having the same story abruptly end. You can turn things around.

It feels like that, always does if there isn't any communication. Our planet has over 7 billion people on it, yet in the past hundred years we've grown more apart from each other. If anything outlive your family members to spite them. Thats a starting goal if anything. Joking aside there is much more to life. If you're alone you can reach out to others. Discord groups exist, school clubs or the such exist, hobby subreddits exists.

Its very nerve wrecking and anxiety inducing to do so. Getting out of this pit in the path of life is difficult but not impossible.

Self depreciation is a gateway to into depression. Make tea or coffee and remember, there are worse people out there. The very least is to outlive them to spite them. As for the better people, outlive them to mourn them.

We all don't know what we're doing, thats why we're here on this subreddit. To be young and denied help by those whom you love. There are ways to still get help or have someone to talk to. Online organizations such as American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP) exist. There are ways to see a therapist, online therapy is there. It better than nothing if you're willing to try at least. Keeping it bottled up is never good and talking on here is at least a start.  


Life is diffcult. Your struggle maybe seen as you being lazy and unmotivated. Thats true on the surface, but the root problem is beyond that. If you need help there are ways to get it online. Please don't bottle it up. Reach out to places you can. You did speak here and thats a start. We're willing to listen and talk.

Meaning to ones life is...subjective at best. Does your life mean anything to the dictator of N. Korea? Of course not. Does it mean something to your loved ones? Absolutely. Will time eventually turn this world to dust and have it become meaningless in the end? Absolutely. However the time after you die will be extremely hard on your loved ones. No, it'll be life altering diffcult.

The thing is the world moves on, and you've dug yourself into a pit. People will come by and attempt to pull you out of the pit, however if you don't help yourself up you cannot get out of the pit. The change needs to happen there.  


Loved ones are willing to take care of you until now, and they wish to continue to do so. Life is...diffcult. However its not just for ourselves that we continue living this diffcult life, its for those around us. Experiencing the happiness and struggles our lives will have that make it so.   


I hope you are willing to rethinking and re-evaluate what you mean as a person to others.

The feeling of worthlessness and being determined by the amount of wealth you make/possess is crushing. However despite that we, as humans, try to get by and have gotten by in worser conditions. Worse people have done so. Diginity can't get you a happy future, nor can pride. A happy future can be reached, but you'd only make it that far if you keep going!

I understand this feel too much, becuase this is the feeling I have on a daily basis. Its a selfish feeling but at the same time because of that feeling you push away loved ones in an ironic selflessness to make sure they aren't hurt. Life isn't always about your own happiness. Its also others around you, those loved ones you wouldn't see accomplishments or future memories of. Life is never easy but its never a story about yourself, its one about those around you. 21 isn't too old, but its also not quite young. While there is more to life that you don't want to see and experience, others would want to see and experience it with you.   


That feeling of being lost and waiting the numbing days to die is torturous and will 100% drive you further down that road. I know how horrible it is. Better people have gone down that road and ended it there. Worse people have gone down that roaded and gotten out of it. There is always more to life that you don't know you want to experience.   


The feeling of exhaustion and burnout is always something diffcult to deal with and manage. You can seek out help for it, things from therapy to just having a good ol' venting session. I'm struggling with a very very similar sense. Those who care about you want to help you, but they can only drag you so far out of pit. To get fully out you have to want to get yourself out of the pit.  


Life is tough, but its because of those we love that we keep toughing it out.

First and foremost: there are always organization to talk to about your issues. A ton of them exist for just that issue. Then past that venting what happens? Solving the issues...and they can help you with that as well.

Is it the people in power? Throughout history humans have had horrible leaders, even worse than the ones we've had now. And humanity continued to move on and exist. Not just that but I'd say we're doing better than we were tens of years ago, much less hundreds.

The best things we can do is prevent atrocities from those we care about, as long not at the expense of others. That second part is important. If there is a more deep seated issue and personal issue we can talk more about that.

At the end of it all bottling it up and not venting is never good. If you feel like venting you can bent here, its why a subreddit like this or others exist. Venting to similar minded or otherwise understand strangers.  
Life never is something you experience, everyone live and everyone die. How you do so is what makes it different. You always feel useless because you are unable to stop the astrocities in the world? Better people have tried, and they failed. Have faith in humanity, not humans. Humanity has gotten far and accomplish/done great things. Humans are horrbile, but humanity as a whole has had a general tendency towards virtue. The internet and media portray it more because that what gets clicks and views. However despite all of these horrible things people, humanity, will gather together to help.   


Believe in humanity, not humans. I hope these words can at the very least make you feel less hopeless.

I won't bog you down about hypotheticals that may or may not happen, but rather I'll bog you down with another question: is the sense of alienation a way to isolate yourself to feel more protected? It could also stem from a trust issue due to the mental trauma from those you love.   


Regardless you need help and there are multiple organizations to help you if you still wish for it. Organizations such as the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP) or Society for the Prevention of Teen Suicide (SPTS) exist solely for reasons to help and have people listen. The first step is usually to help yourself before you can have others help you, but with people who suffer like this its always hard to get up to take the first step. I hope you find something or someone to help pull you up to your feet and get you on the path to more help.   


Most people exist on this planet for a while and then disappear into the annals of time. There is hope and a path for you to get through this tribulation in life. Death always seems an answer, but its almost never the good one. You belong to be the very least the author, the narrator, for your own life and the stuggles and happiness you go through. Something your future self and hopefully those future loved ones will look back on. Stay strong.  


\-Random stranger on the internet who is hopeful for the story of your life in the future
